reviewer_scope: Read-only source review and bounded SQLite read-only queries; no global job/test suite/engine restarted, no production edited.
reviewed_invariants: Original IDs, ordered node associations, XZ, names/full tags, modes/access/directions, navigation edges, render-hub constraints and protected ramp orders are included in exact before/after signatures. Only declared metric bounds, inference rows and Y are excluded.

The source-only clone checks the pinned predecessor DB hash and terminal rejected-profile status, refuses mutated Y or an already-migrated v3 schema, and recomputes full source conservation against the recovered R5 source. Failed predecessor solved Y is not adopted.

Compatible bridge/tunnel plus level runs cross arbitrary way splits. Different structure/level transitions require the same original source node and exact zero length/allowance. Coordinates alone do not create a portal or navigation edge.
Height-only geometry adjacency can affect available height-distance and flat components but is not emitted as navigation adjacency or reported as original network distance.

Near-portal offsets are relative to solved portal height; short runs explicitly remain below nominal offset. Far interior DEM+6 or DEM-5 and relative constraints are both identified as game reconstruction, not clearance survey.

Sparse protected ramp orders remain distinct; structure relations are separately bounded100000, ramp relations4096 and closure64rounds. Budget rejection is unresolved work, not proof of source impossibility.

The solver verifies every current edge allowance, height-only allowance and relative gap before writing Y. Source graph car allowances remain0.12; foot0.25/steps0.7 are not promoted into the car physical producer/native0.122 contract.
Output remains graph/profile-only with physical_tiles empty. Actual ribbon slope, Float32/native geometry, terrain cover, bridge deck clearance and pedestrian-only support remain later gates.

APFS clone is explicit, failure does not launch an unbounded fallback. Direct filesystem free reserve and logical output budget are checked before/during/after the owned CPU child; signal handling terminates/reaps its owned worker.
tests_reviewed_not_rerun_by_reviewer: Five endpoint tests: source parking ramp, refusal without Y write, same-structure way split, explicit subnominal short structure and ten actual portal witnesses with preserved source topology.
Two CPU lifecycle tests: fast-finished over-budget output rejected and supervisor SIGTERM reaps owned worker.
Semantic source/grade tests and original-source audit are part of frozen predecessor/continuation evidence; not reinterpreted as native tests.
not_verified_by_this_review: Independent all-emitted-graph auditor being written/run separately by road worker
Physical national meshes, geographic over/under clearance and native full-country traversal
Default SourceWorld adoption, rendered quality and performance
Full user goal or exact surveyed Singapore elevation acceptance
